rows.name: THE SIGNATURE
rows.description: The HERO product. Small F2D bee logo on front left chest (3.5"), full "FLESH TO DEATH" bee on honeycomb on back (14" x 16"). Professional front = wearable anywhere. MASSIVE back design = statement piece when riding. People behind you at stoplights will remember this.

rows.name: THE DAILY RIDER
rows.description: Bold circle badge logo on front center (10"), "HONEY CO. Nevada Apiary • Est. 2025" text across shoulders on back (11" wide). Classic MC/riding culture badge design. Less aggressive than huge back print = more wearable. Best seller potential - appeals to widest audience.

rows.name: THE FLAG BEARER
rows.description: Front-heavy design: Bee with flag banner "FLESH TO DEATH" and "HONEY CO." (11" x 13"). Skull with honeycomb pattern on back (6" x 8"). Eye-catching flag banner is unique. Great conversation starter. Perfect for when YOU'RE leading the pack.

rows.name: Skull Wrench Sticker
rows.description: Die-cut vinyl sticker featuring the iconic skull with wrench. Weather-resistant, perfect for helmets, tanks, and toolboxes.

rows.name: Flesh to Death Flag Sticker
rows.description: Die-cut vinyl sticker of the classic F2D pennant flag. Slap it anywhere that needs more attitude.

rows.name: Honey Jar Sticker
rows.description: Die-cut vinyl sticker of the Flesh to Death honey jar. Sweet and rebellious.

rows.name: Poker Chip Sticker
rows.description: Die-cut vinyl sticker of the F2D poker chip. For those who gamble with fate.

rows.name: Bee Head Sticker
rows.description: Die-cut vinyl sticker of the biker bee mascot. The face of the hive.

rows.name: F2D Sticker Pack
rows.description: Complete set of all 5 Flesh to Death stickers. Save $10 when you buy the pack.

rows.name: Skull Wrench Patch
rows.description: Embroidered iron-on patch featuring the skull with wrench. 3.5" diameter.

rows.name: F2D Circle Badge Patch
rows.description: Embroidered iron-on patch of the classic circle badge logo. 4" diameter.
